policy_positions.stance_summary: Focus on economic empowerment through non-oil sector investment, job creation, and supporting agriculture, technology, and renewable energy sectors.
verified_statements: Economic growth must translate into job creation, higher incomes, and expanded opportunities for citizens.
Creative industry has the potential to generate 2.7 million jobs.
policy_positions.source: Office of the Speaker, Various 2024-2025 statements

policy_positions.stance_summary: Advocates for credible budget targets and disciplined implementation. Backed single fiscal framework for order and accountability.
verified_actions: Approved extension of 2025 capital budget implementation to March 31, 2026

policy_positions.stance_summary: Security as fundamental basis for development, food production, and investment. Advocated for ECOWAS standby force to deter coups. Notes porous borders contribute to insecurity.

quotes.text: Security is a fundamental basis for development, food production, and investment.

policy_positions.stance_summary: Championed increased health allocations - 5.46% in 2024 leading to revitalization of 4,000 primary healthcare centers.
Supporter of Student Loans Act and increased education allocations. Focus on human capital development.
actions: Supported passage of Student Loans (Access to Higher Education) Act

policy_positions.stance_summary: Committed to transparent governance, public engagement, and strengthening National Human Rights Commission. Supports independent body for political party funding oversight.

quotes.text: We pledge to engage Nigerians, report on legislative performance, and recalibrate efforts based on feedback.

policy_positions.stance_summary: Advocates for Africa's proper inclusion in UN main decision-making system. Urges reform of UN Security Council and Bretton Woods system to reflect Africa's demographic reality.
policy_positions.source: National Assembly Library Trust Fund speech
